# Neon MCP Hub — Complete 20 B2B MCP Server Reference (llms-full.txt)

> Machine-readable specification of 20 Pay-Per-Event B2B Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers hosted on Apify Cloud (`veteran_steam_iyn`), including 10 Live Official-API Flagship servers and an open-core local Python stdio server (`neon_mcp_server.py`).
> Canonical Hub: https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/
> GitHub Repository: https://github.com/zhuangruoxiong-cpu/neon-mcp-hub

## Trade Show Exhibitor Directory Extractor (MCP & PPE) (`veteran_steam_iyn/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp`)
- **Direct Answer**: Extract clean B2B exhibitor records (company, booth, category, website) from public trade show directories. MCP-ready for AI Agents.
- **Pricing**: `$0.015` USD per `exhibitor_record_extracted` (Pay-Per-Event, zero subscription)
- **Authenticated MCP Endpoint**: `https://mcp.apify.com/?actors=veteran_steam_iyn/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp` (Header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIFY_TOKEN`)
- **Documentation Page**: https://zhuangruoxiong-cpu.github.io/neon-mcp-hub/actors/niche-tradeshow-exhibitor-mcp.html
